AIIMS forms panel to investigate teen patient's death

The All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) has formed a committee to investigate the death of a 15-year-old patient. The patient's father alleged that the death occurred due to a 13-year delay in receiving heart surgery. He is seeking justice for his son. The specific cause of death and the timeline of the patient's treatment at AIIMS are under investigation by the newly formed panel.
